node.label: Gaucher disease-ophthalmoplegia-cardiovascular calcification syndrome
node.definition: Gaucher disease - ophthalmoplegia - cardiovascular calcification is a variant of Gaucher disease, also known as a Gaucher-like disease that is characterized by cardiac involvement.

neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. Gaucher disease-ophthalmoplegia-cardiovascular calcification syndrome: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome: type 1 interferonopathy (innate immune activation) (via MONDO:0700264 type 1 interferonopathy). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.17. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for RNASEH2A, RNASEH2B, RNASEH2C, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
